note: RV park behind the Lake Andes Inn motel on US-18 in Lake Andes, a short walk from the lake and about 5 minutes from Pickstown and Fort Randall Dam; restaurant, gas stations and grocery within walking distance. Self-contained rigs only: there are no restrooms or showers for RV guests. Spots also sold by the week, month and year, and the inn markets extended stays to work crews. --Claude
